set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the hostname of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The hostname of the device, used to identify the device in the network.

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-1/0/1.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: Configure OSPF protocol area and the interface that participates in OSPF.

parameters.name: area
parameters.explanation: OSPF area identifier, commonly represented as an IP address.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The interface name and unit number that participates in OSPF, such as ge-1/0/1.0.
